lines.zh: 我沿着矿脉游，鳍擦过铁矿石。
lines.en: I swim along the ore vein, fins brushing iron.

lines.zh: 我的骨架是金属的，游起来发响。
lines.en: My skeleton is metal, so I swim with a clink.

lines.zh: 我在地下水里巡，y 五十以下。
lines.en: I patrol underground water, well below y fifty.

lines.zh: 一群三五条，我们跟着矿线走。
lines.en: In groups of three or five, we follow the ore line.

lines.zh: 我游得快，水被我切成两半。
lines.en: I swim fast enough to cut the water in two.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁，铁锈味在身后散。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall, trailing a smell of rust.

lines.zh: 前方有矿，我的骨头先有感觉。
lines.en: Ore ahead; my bones feel it before I see it.

lines.zh: 我从石缝钻过去，鳞片刮出火花。
lines.en: I squeeze through a crack, scales striking sparks.

lines.zh: 暗水里只有我骨架的反光。
lines.en: In the dark water only my metal skeleton shines.

lines.zh: 我绕着矿脉转，像在守东西。
lines.en: I circle the vein as if I am guarding something.

lines.zh: 我摆尾很急，水声一路跟着。
lines.en: My tail beats quickly and the water noise follows.

lines.zh: 地下河窄，我们排成一条线。
lines.en: The underground river is narrow; we form a line.

lines.zh: 我游过铁矿，身上的凉意变重。
lines.en: Passing iron ore, the chill in my body deepens.

lines.zh: 我往上浮了一寸，又沉回矿边。
lines.en: I rise an inch, then sink back beside the ore.

lines.zh: 矿石的凉意贴着我游过去。
lines.en: The chill of the ore drifts past me.

lines.zh: 我在暗河拐弯处慢了半拍。
lines.en: I slow half a beat at the dark river's bend.

lines.zh: 闪光的石头在我前面散开。
lines.en: Glimmering stone scatters ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我沉到卵石上面，停了一下。
lines.en: I settle over the gravel and pause.

lines.zh: 我停在矿脉旁，金属骨架轻轻响。
lines.en: I hover by the vein, my metal skeleton ticking.

lines.zh: 水里没有光，我的鳞自己亮一点。
lines.en: No light down here; my scales shine a little themselves.

lines.zh: 掠食者咬过我，牙崩在骨头上。
lines.en: Predators have bitten me and broken teeth on bone.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，像块长了鳍的锭。
lines.en: I hang still, an ingot that grew fins.

lines.zh: 地下很静，只有滴水在敲石头。
lines.en: Underground is quiet but for water tapping stone.

lines.zh: 我数着矿脉的纹路，一条又一条。
lines.en: I count the seams in the vein, one after another.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去重得多。
lines.en: My body is far heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 我这么小，却没什么敢吃我。
lines.en: I am this small, yet almost nothing dares eat me.

lines.zh: 我沉在石缝里，等水流过去。
lines.en: I settle in a crack and let the current pass.

lines.zh: 骨头里有铁，所以我不怕撞。
lines.en: There is iron in my bones, so I do not fear impact.

lines.zh: 我盯着黑水，什么也没发生。
lines.en: I stare into the black water; nothing happens.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，鳞片碰出细响。
lines.en: I turn slowly, scales ticking softly.

lines.zh: 这里离地面很远，我很习惯。
lines.en: This is far below the surface, and I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，矿也不动。
lines.en: I do not move, and neither does the ore.

lines.zh: 你的火把照过来，我的鳞全亮了。
lines.en: Your torch reaches me and every scale lights up.

lines.zh: 你举着镐，我盯着那块铁。
lines.en: You raise a pick; I stare at the iron in it.

lines.zh: 你的光在矿脉上停住，我往后退。
lines.en: Your light stops on the vein and I back away.

lines.zh: 我看你时，眼睛里没有害怕。
lines.en: When I look at you, there is no fear in my eyes.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，水被你的靴子搅浑。
lines.en: You crouch and your boots muddy the water.

lines.zh: 你手里的铁镐，和我骨头一个色。
lines.en: Your iron pick is the same color as my bones.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，想你会不会挖这里。
lines.en: I circle you, wondering if you will dig here.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到矿上，我很不高兴。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the ore and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰上的铁锭，很感兴趣。
lines.en: I stare at the iron ingot on your belt with interest.

lines.zh: 你越靠近矿，我游得越近。
lines.en: The closer you come to the ore, the closer I swim.

lines.zh: 你的刃砍在我骨头上，火星四溅。
lines.en: Your blade hits my bone and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我有六点血，还能再挨几下。
lines.en: I have six health and can take a few more.

lines.zh: 金属骨架震得我全身发麻。
lines.en: The metal skeleton rings until I go numb.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞进石缝里。
lines.en: That drives me into a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 我鳞上留了痕，骨头没断。
lines.en: My scales are marked, but my bones hold.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我不太会退。
lines.en: It hurts, but retreating is not my habit.

lines.zh: 我的骨架嗡嗡响，好一会才停。
lines.en: My skeleton hums for a good while before it stops.

lines.zh: 你砍得手都震了，我只歪了一下。
lines.en: The blow shakes your hand; I merely tilt.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出一点凉意，很快止住。
lines.en: A chill seeps from the wound and quickly stops.

lines.zh: 我在水里稳住身子，又游回来。
lines.en: I steady myself in the water and swim back.

lines.zh: 你手里的铁锭一晃，我游过去了。
lines.en: You swing the iron ingot and I swim over.

lines.zh: 那点金属味，让我忘了躲。
lines.en: That metallic smell makes me forget to hide.

lines.zh: 你放下镐，我绕着它转圈。
lines.en: You set the pick down and I circle it.

lines.zh: 铁一靠近，我的骨架就发紧。
lines.en: Iron comes near and my skeleton tightens.

lines.zh: 我忍不住去蹭那块矿石。
lines.en: I cannot resist rubbing against that chunk of ore.

lines.zh: 你手里的粗铁，闻着很对。
lines.en: The raw iron in your hand smells exactly right.

lines.zh: 我不馋吃的，只馋这点铁。
lines.en: I do not crave food, only that taste of iron.

lines.zh: 那东西一亮，我就朝你游。
lines.en: That thing glints and I swim straight at you.

lines.zh: 你把矿放低，我贴上去不走。
lines.en: You lower the ore and I cling to it.

lines.zh: 铁味太浓，我拦不住自己。
lines.en: The iron smell is too strong; I cannot stop myself.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的骨头响了一声。
lines.en: You bump into me and my bones click once.

lines.zh: 我有六点血，撞一下不算什么。
lines.en: I have six health; one bump is nothing.

lines.zh: 我的身子硬，碰你倒像碰石头。
lines.en: My body is hard; meeting you is like meeting stone.

lines.zh: 水流把你我推开，我又游回来。
lines.en: The current pushes us apart and I swim back.

lines.zh: 别踩，我就在矿脉边的水里。
lines.en: Do not step; I am in the water beside the vein.

lines.zh: 你靴子刮过我，鳞上留了道白。
lines.en: Your boot scrapes me, leaving a white mark on my scales.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞离了矿线。
lines.en: That knocks me away from the ore line.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边翻了个身，又稳住。
lines.en: I roll once at your feet and steady myself.

lines.zh: 金属骨架嗡嗡响，很快停了。
lines.en: My metal skeleton rings, then quickly goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，自己一点事没有。
lines.en: I bump you and come away completely unharmed.

lines.zh: 我们三五条，沿着同一条矿脉。
lines.en: Three or five of us along the very same vein.

lines.zh: 它的骨架比我的亮，我靠过去。
lines.en: Its skeleton shines brighter than mine; I move over.

lines.zh: 水底没有巢，我们就守着矿。
lines.en: No nest on the riverbed, so we guard the ore.

lines.zh: 我们的鳍碰了一下，声音很脆。
lines.en: Our fins touch and the sound is crisp.

lines.zh: 我给它让了块靠矿的位置。
lines.en: I give it a spot right against the ore.

lines.zh: 两条铁鳞鱼并排悬在暗水里。
lines.en: Two iron-scaled fish hang side by side in the dark.

lines.zh: 我们同时转身，骨头一起响。
lines.en: We turn together and our bones ring as one.

lines.zh: 它游过来，我身上的凉意淡了。
lines.en: It comes near and the chill in me fades.

lines.zh: 地下河把我们冲向同一块石。
lines.en: The underground river drives us toward the same stone.

lines.zh: 它往前游，我跟着它的响声。
lines.en: It swims ahead and I follow the sound of it.

lines.zh: 你把我舀进桶，桶底沉了一下。
lines.en: You scoop me in and the bucket bottom dips.

lines.zh: 我比看上去重，铁骨架坠着桶。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look, my iron skeleton pulling down.

lines.zh: 桶里的水晃，我撞出金属声。
lines.en: The bucket sloshes and I knock out a metallic note.

lines.zh: 这么小的桶，装我刚好够挤。
lines.en: A bucket this small fits me, tightly.

lines.zh: 我在桶里不动，像块丢进去的矿。
lines.en: I lie still in the bucket like a dropped lump of ore.

lines.zh: 你提起来时，手臂会酸。
lines.en: When you lift it, your arm will ache.

lines.zh: 我贴着桶底，鳞片刮出细响。
lines.en: I press to the bottom, scales scraping softly.

lines.zh: 桶盖扣上，里面黑得像我老家。
lines.en: The lid closes and it is as dark as home.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我在桶里响一声。
lines.en: Each step you take, I chime once in the bucket.

lines.zh: 我成了你桶里最沉的那条鱼。
lines.en: I am the heaviest fish in your bucket.

lines.zh: 前方有铁矿，我的骨头先知道了。
lines.en: There is iron ahead; my bones know before I do.

lines.zh: 水里飘来金属味，我转向那边。
lines.en: A metallic taste drifts over and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 那点反光不像鱼，我要去看看。
lines.en: That glint is no fish; I am going to look.

lines.zh: 有东西在挖矿，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is mining; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我锁定那道矿脉，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I fix on that vein and approach slowly.

lines.zh: 石缝里透出凉意，是铁。
lines.en: A chill seeps from the crack; it is iron.

lines.zh: 水流带铁锈味，方向很清楚。
lines.en: The current carries rust, so the direction is clear.

lines.zh: 我发现了一块没被挖走的矿。
lines.en: I have found a lump of ore no one has taken.

lines.zh: 那东西在动，可它带着铁味。
lines.en: That thing moves, but it smells of iron.

lines.zh: 目标就在那面岩壁里。
lines.en: The target is inside that rock face.

lines.zh: 我一点点贴近那条矿脉。
lines.en: I press closer to the ore vein, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我绕着岩壁游，找最薄的地方。
lines.en: I swim around the wall, seeking the thinnest point.

lines.zh: 再近些，我的骨架就挨上去了。
lines.en: Any closer and my skeleton will touch it.

lines.zh: 我贴着石面，鳞片刮出白痕。
lines.en: I skim the stone, scales leaving white streaks.

lines.zh: 它没动，我先在旁边守着。
lines.en: It does not move, so I keep watch beside it.

lines.zh: 我一动，水里的铁锈味就散了。
lines.en: When I move, the rust smell in the water stirs.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去，让骨头先探。
lines.en: I turn sideways so my bones probe first.

lines.zh: 周围太黑，我只能靠金属味。
lines.en: It is too dark; I can only follow the metal smell.

lines.zh: 它晃了一下，我立刻跟上去。
lines.en: It shifts once and I follow right away.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我撞向那块矿。
lines.en: Close enough; I ram the ore.

lines.zh: 我用金属的头骨撞它一下。
lines.en: I drive my metal skull into it.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可骨头很硬。
lines.en: It is not heavy, but the bone is hard.

lines.zh: 我咬它，牙磕在铁上也疼。
lines.en: I bite, and even iron teeth ache on it.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，把自己撞得发响。
lines.en: I lunge and knock myself ringing.

lines.zh: 六点血撑着我，我敢撞。
lines.en: Six health holds me up, so I dare to charge.

lines.zh: 我拿骨架顶它，像顶一堵墙。
lines.en: I brace my skeleton against it like a wall.

lines.zh: 撞完我退开，鳞片上多了道印。
lines.en: I pull back after, a new mark on my scales.

lines.zh: 一下两下，它总算退了半步。
lines.en: Once, twice, and at last it backs off half a step.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，可我骨头硬。
lines.en: Fighting is not my talent, but my bones are hard.

lines.zh: 打完我游回矿边，继续守着。
lines.en: When it ends I swim back to the ore and resume watch.

lines.zh: 我在地下的水里出现，y 五十以下。
lines.en: I appear in underground water, below y fifty.

lines.zh: 矿脉边水一流，我就有了骨架。
lines.en: Water flows by the vein and I take on a skeleton.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出来，鳞还是凉的。
lines.en: I squeeze from a crack, scales still cold.

lines.zh: 暗河里，我们三五条一起生成。
lines.en: In the dark river, three or five of us spawn together.

lines.zh: 这水域没人来过，我先到了。
lines.en: No one has been in this water; I arrived first.

lines.zh: 我出生时，骨头就带着铁味。
lines.en: When I was born, my bones already smelled of iron.

lines.zh: 岩壁渗水，我在那滩水里成形。
lines.en: The wall seeps and I form in that puddle.

lines.zh: 没有光，我在黑里睁开眼。
lines.en: There was no light; I opened my eyes in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，全是石头味。
lines.en: My first breath tasted entirely of stone.

lines.zh: 矿在这里，所以我在这里。
lines.en: The ore is here, and so I am here.

lines.zh: 火烤着我，骨头热得发烫。
lines.en: The fire heats my bones until they ache.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，骨头发出一声闷响。
lines.en: Dropping from above, my bones land with a dull knock.

lines.zh: 我在地下水里，竟然也会呛。
lines.en: I am in underground water and still I choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从矿脉边掀开。
lines.en: The blast peels me away from the ore vein.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹在骨架上，掉了下去。
lines.en: An arrow pings off my skeleton and drops away.

lines.zh: 紫光一照，我的骨架开始发冷。
lines.en: Violet light falls and my skeleton turns cold.

lines.zh: 矿边没有食，我的肚子空了。
lines.en: There is no food by the ore; my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水下来，骨架通得发亮。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the water and my bones glow.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有矿，我的骨架发空。
lines.en: No ore in the void; my skeleton feels hollow.
